name: Miss Muffetson
premise: A spider leading an arachnophobia support group: exposure therapy where she is the exposure, with two-column graduation stats.

sample.joke: Welcome back. I see everyone returned, which is growth. Tonight: we sit near the fear. Not ON the fear — near it. Brenda, you are on the fear. Scoot half an inch toward courage. There. Now breathe. I am breathing too. Can you hear it? Good. That means I'm close. That means it's working.
